plugins.name: mindpowers
plugins.description: One loop for knowledge work: shape, draft, review, remember. Mindstorming (formerly brainstorming) refines rough ideas into locked specs through Socratic dialogue; drafting turns locked specs into deliverables; reviewing-docs checks any doc against the template's standards; calibrating remembers what you like for next time. Templates cover business reviews, decision docs, PRDs, briefing docs, comms drafts, frameworks, talking points, and post-mortems.
